payload.core_composition_summary: Sort distances, two-pointer sweep from high to low to compute per-team 3-point counts, store in hash maps, then evaluate all distinct thresholds.
payload.rationale: Combines sorting to order data, two-pointer amortized scan for efficient suffix count computation, and hash maps for constant-time retrieval during brute-force evaluation over distinct distances.
